name: Exit initiated
description: Capture the reason for leaving, resignation or termination date, and the official last working day. Recorded when the exit is started; editable until the exit is complete.

name: Handover
description: Generate the handover email to the reporting manager (Accounts and HR are always CC'd) plus the handover checklist. Copy or open in your mail client - no email is sent automatically. Mark complete once the reporting manager confirms go-ahead.

name: No Dues / Notice Certificate
description: Record the full-and-final settlement figures and words, last drawn salary and pending items, then upload the signed No Dues letter (or generate a draft from the template to send for signing). Uploading the final letter completes the step. HR and Admin only.

name: Full and final settlement
description: Record the settlement amount and payment confirmation (date and reference). HR and Admin only.

name: Relieving letter
description: Upload the final relieving letter (signed / on letterhead), or generate a draft from the Relieving template. Either completes the step.

name: Experience letter
description: Upload the final experience letter (signed / on letterhead), or generate a draft from the Experience template. Either completes the step.
